title: ci: review pull requests with Claude Opus 5.5
body:
## Summary

Sets `model: claude-opus-5-5` in the Wachi Reviewer caller workflow, replacing the Sonnet 5.5 default.

## Why

Recent reviews on Sonnet 5.5 cost $0.03–0.15 each. Opus 5.5 is twice the per-token price ($4 / $20 per MTok against $2 / $10), so a similar review should land around $0.06–0.30. That estimate assumes Opus uses a similar number of tokens, which is not measured yet. The default caps are unchanged and still bound every run: $0.75 per batch and $3 per review.

## Verification

This pull request runs its own automatic review with the edited workflow, because `pull_request` uses the head's workflow file. The review footer should read "Claude Opus 5.5" and show the cost.
